---
title: 'E2E pilot and Playwright retirement'
description: 'Compare Playwright and e2e pilot results, collect CI and maintenance evidence, and decide when to retire or restore an individual suite.'
updatedAt: '2026-11-27'
audience: developers
---

Run the existing hand-written Playwright suites alongside `e2e-inc/e2e` for
14 days, from 27 November 2026 to 11 December 2026 (ICT, UTC+7). Playwright
remains authoritative during the pilot. The `e2e` runs are report-only and use
strict-cache replay in CI. An eligible result requires a suite owner’s explicit
acknowledgment before any retirement. See the
[framework setup](/build/development-tools/e2e-framework).

| Surface | Suite ID | Pilot coverage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Upskii | `core-role-matrix` | Authorization across 25 role-matrix cases |
| Upskii | `tutor-file-picker` | Tutor file picker |
| Upskii | `class-settings` | Both Class settings variants |
| Upskii | `learner-class-join` | Learner class-join |
| Upskii | `assessment-reorder` | Assessment reorder, gated on the Upskii lead’s train |
| Tuturuuu Web | `tasks-kanban` | Tasks Kanban, including filtered-empty state |
| Tuturuuu Web | `meet-guest-join` | Meet guest join and lobby |
| Tuturuuu Web | `login-en-vi` | Login in English and Vietnamese |
| EduFest | `edufest-hall-guest-join` | Hall guest join alongside the authoritative W4/EduFest harness |
| Flutter | `mobile-calendar` | Calendar in `apps/mobile/e2e` via `@e2e-dev/mobile` |

| Flutter | `mobile-contacts` | Contacts in `apps/mobile/e2e` via `@e2e-dev/mobile` |

## Collect reports and update history

Run each suite against the same commit and fixture for both frameworks. Use one
report per suite, framework, and CI attempt. Give both frameworks the same
`runId` for that attempt, including any rerun attempt number. Use the tested
commit’s full SHA, the run start timestamp with its offset, and `ci: true` for
CI results.

Use the Playwright JSON reporter to preserve retry outcomes. If you use JUnit,
set `PLAYWRIGHT_JUNIT_INCLUDE_RETRIES=1`. Use a consistent report format per
framework across runs so test identities stay comparable. For `e2e`, collect
`.e2e/report.json` and `.e2e/junit.xml`. The JSON report supplies runner wall
time and model-call accounting. The optional `junit` field validates the
companion report without counting the cases again. An `e2e` JUnit-only input
can supply outcomes, with model-call coverage marked unknown. Use
`durationMs` to supply measured wall time when the report lacks it.

Save a manifest such as `tmp/e2e/pilot-manifest.json`. Report paths resolve
relative to the manifest.

```json
{
  "suites": {
    "edufest-hall-guest-join": { "workshopCritical": true }
  },
  "runs": [
    {
      "suite": "edufest-hall-guest-join",
      "framework": "playwright",
      "runId": "ci-123-attempt-1",
      "timestamp": "2026-11-27T09:00:00+07:00",
      "commitSha": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567",
      "ci": true,
      "report": "artifacts/playwright.json"
    },
    {
      "suite": "edufest-hall-guest-join",
      "framework": "e2e",
      "runId": "ci-123-attempt-1",
      "timestamp": "2026-11-27T09:00:00+07:00",
      "commitSha": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567",
      "ci": true,
      "report": "artifacts/.e2e/report.json",
      "junit": "artifacts/.e2e/junit.xml"
    }
  ]
}
```

Keep the workshop policy in each summary invocation, including when you
summarize history alone. A policy-only manifest can omit `runs`. Set
`runtimeCapMs` in the suite policy when the owner has agreed to an absolute CI
runtime cap.

Run from the repository root. On the first invocation, omit `--history`.
Reuse `--history-out` as the next invocation’s input. Use one writer for the
history and archive the raw artifacts before CI retention expires.

```bash
node scripts/e2e/pilot-metrics.mjs \
  --manifest tmp/e2e/pilot-manifest.json \
  --history tmp/e2e/pilot-history.ndjson \
  --history-out tmp/e2e/pilot-history.ndjson \
  --as-of 2026-12-11 \
  --json-out tmp/e2e/pilot-summary.json \
  --markdown-out tmp/e2e/pilot-summary.md \
  --assert-zero-model-calls
```

During collection, omit `--as-of` to use the current time. Use the pilot end
date to reproduce the final decision. Date-only values start at midnight ICT.
The tool deduplicates identical snapshots by run ID, timestamp, suite, and
framework and rejects conflicting snapshots. It accepts a JSON array, a
single JSON snapshot, or NDJSON. The output history keeps the current
14-day window. Omit `--markdown-out` to write the Markdown summary to stdout,
or append the saved file to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`. The model-call assertion
exits nonzero on a positive or unknown total in any CI snapshot supplied.

## Record maintenance and triage failures

Add one entry per break and framework to
[`.e2e/pilot-maintenance-log.json`](https://github.com/tutur3u/platform/blob/main/.e2e/pilot-maintenance-log.json).
Keep the schema reference and add the suite ID, framework, full tested commit
SHA, offset-qualified `recordedAt`, and a short note on what broke. Record
actual repair minutes in `minutesToFix`, including re-recording for `e2e` or
editing selectors for Playwright. Use zero for a confirmed break that needed
no repair. Classify `failureCategory` as `real-regression`,
`ui-change-false-failure`, or `infra-flake`.

Triage each failing Playwright CI run and include its `runId` on the ledger
entries. A real regression needs a stable `regressionId`. If both frameworks
caught it on the same CI attempt, record the same ID on both entries. Use the
same suite, SHA, and run ID. A passing candidate or an unmatched detection
counts as a miss. If any baseline failure remains untriaged, leave the suite
in Playwright.

| Metric | How the summary measures it |
| --- | --- |
| Pass, fail, and flake rate per test | A retry-pass counts as a pass and a flake. If outcomes mix on the same SHA, each failing observation counts as a flake. Flake rate divides flaky observations by passes plus failures. Skips have their own count. The JSON includes per-test detail. |
| UI-change false failures | Count and share of logged breaks classified as `ui-change-false-failure`. A framework with zero logged breaks has a zero rate. |
| Maintenance time | Mean and median minutes per break for each framework and the ratio of their means. Zero candidate breaks contribute zero repair burden to the ratio. |
| CI runtime | Mean and nearest-rank p95 runner wall time. Totals sum the known suite wall times in each CI batch. Concurrent suite totals measure runner time. |
| Model calls | Total model calls and maximum per test. A test’s calls include its retries. CI requires a known zero total for every supplied CI run. |

## Apply the retirement criteria

Use the per-suite decision and its criterion results in the JSON summary.
Aggregates describe the pilot as a whole. Apply these gates to each suite.

| Criterion | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Elapsed window and sample | At least 14 elapsed days and 10 paired CI attempts per suite on matching run ID and commit SHA. Each side must execute at least one test to a verdict without a run-level error. |
| Flake rate | The `e2e` CI flake rate is at most the Playwright CI flake rate. |
| Maintenance | The `e2e` mean repair time is strictly below 50% of the Playwright mean. Zero Playwright breaks return `insufficient-break-data`. A zero Playwright mean has no valid ratio. |
| UI-change false failures | The `e2e` false-failure rate is at most the Playwright rate. |
| Model calls | 100% of CI runs have a known total of exactly zero. |
| CI runtime | The `e2e` mean CI wall time is at most 1.25 times the Playwright mean, or at most the explicit suite cap. All CI runs need wall-time evidence. |
| Real regressions | Every failing baseline run is triaged and `e2e` misses zero confirmed Playwright detections. |
| W4 and EduFest | Tag all workshop-critical suites with `workshopCritical: true`. The authoritative W4/EduFest harness stays in place through 5 December 2026 ICT. Evaluations return `HELD_UNTIL_DEC_5` until midnight at the start of 6 December, even if every quantitative gate passes. |

## Retire or restore one suite

1. Keep Playwright authoritative for any result other than
   `ELIGIBLE_FOR_RETIREMENT_ACK`. Continue collecting or repairing evidence
   for `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` or `KEEP_PLAYWRIGHT`.
2. For an eligible suite, attach the summary, tested SHA, and artifact links to
   the decision record. Obtain an explicit acknowledgment from the suite owner.
3. Retire that suite in a scoped change. Keep a revertable reference to its
   Playwright spec, job, and fixture settings. Verify the replacement on the
   exact change with strict-cache CI and zero model calls.
4. If the replacement misses a regression or breaks the CI criteria, revert
   the suite retirement. Restore the baseline job and spec, set `e2e` back to
   report-only for that suite, and run both suites on the same SHA. Reapply the
   gates and obtain a fresh acknowledgment before retiring it again.

Run the [pilot metrics regression tests](https://github.com/tutur3u/platform/blob/main/scripts/e2e/pilot-metrics.test.mjs)
with `node --test scripts/e2e/pilot-metrics.test.mjs`. They cover report parsing,
history deduplication, metric formulas, the calendar hold, and CLI output and
exit behavior.
